title: ConvertRequest v1
description: Convert this Latin (Arabizi) text. Sent by the keyboard to the engine, and read by arabizi-cli as one JSON object per line. Swift: ArabiziContracts.ConvertRequest. Explained in docs/API_CONTRACTS.md.

v.description: Contract version; anything else is rejected.

id.description: Request id (UUID), echoed in the response.

text.description: The Latin text as typed. The engine's limit is max_input_chars in config/engine.json.

deadlineMs.description: How long the caller waits for the model before the rule fallback answers.
